raw_text:
Yes, and Augustine wrote that when ministers stay at their posts in danger, none are cheated of the communion of the Lord's body [[lpc.witness.the-dying-and-the-pastors-post]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We offered the sacrifice of the Mediator for our dead, and we gave alms in the church on their behalf [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Augustine taught that gifts at the altar help only the baptized dead who earned that help in life [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Augustine's mother, Monica, asked her sons only to remember her at the Lord's altar, wherever they might be [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]].

npnf101_augustine-confessions-letters.xml, writes of the sacrament as the body and blood of the Lord [[cic:npnf101_augustine-confessions-letters.xml:vii.1.LIV/line28543#02]] [[as:paraphrase]]. npnf101_augustine-confessions-letters.xml, writes that one who dares not take the sacrament every day and one who dares not omit it any day both wish to honour it [[cic:npnf101_augustine-confessions-letters.xml:vii.1.LIV/line28543#02]] [[as:paraphrase]]. npnf105_augustine-anti-pelagian-writings.xml, writes that the Christians of Carthage call baptism salvation and the sacrament of the body of Christ life [[cic:npnf105_augustine-anti-pelagian-writings.xml:x.iii.xxxiv#01]] [[as:paraphrase]].

What an ordinary believer felt walking up to the altar, our records do not give [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]].
